capabilities: Import RTM tasks into notes with due dates, priorities, and tags
Add tasks from the editor to Remember The Milk via commands
Complete RTM tasks from the cursor in Obsidian
Create separate Obsidian notes from selected RTM tasks
Filter RTM imports with custom queries like list:Inbox
extras: Users must apply for their own non-commercial RTM API key and complete a browser-based auth flow; README includes a full Japanese translation and manual installation steps.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync task lists with an external task service like Remember The Milk.

relations.evidence: designed to be fully compatible with the Obsidian Tasks plugin

requires.name: Remember The Milk API Key and Shared Secret

summary: Syncs tasks between Obsidian and Remember The Milk, importing tasks with metadata and pushing new tasks in Tasks-plugin format.
